steps.text: Start Anubis and open the local address. Retrieve your private token from [[value:.anubis/identities.json]]. Paste it into [[field:Access token]] and click [[control:Open workspace]]. Never share the token.

Click [[control:Consultant Copilot]]. Set [[field:Customer workload name]] = [[value:Quartz Industrial Research assisted playbook]]. Set [[field:Data classification]] = [[value:Public — permitted for direct provider processing]]. Click [[control:Start assisted engagement]].

Select your tested connection in [[field:Model connection]]. Enter the following paragraph in [[field:What should we know about the workload?]]: [[value:Fictional customer Quartz Industrial Research. This is a planning exercise. Activities can overlap. A single organisation uses the factory. Use the exact activity name "Fluid simulation". It performs fluid simulation using a GPU solver, not a language model. Compute is inside this AI Factory. Shared capacity within its activity pool. The consultant will enter the workload-specific reference capacity and memory measurements in the guided reference form after reviewing the architecture. Do not use text-token sizing for this activity.]].

Append the following paragraph to [[field:What should we know about the workload?]]: [[value:Do not add other activities or infer local storage from an outside corpus. Unknown storage and network measurements remain unknown.]]. Click [[control:Ask copilot]].
Wait while Copilot interprets the description. The active status indicator confirms that it is still working. Do not submit duplicate requests.

Review the proposed activities, placement, measurements and assumptions against the input register. Check [[field:I reviewed the selected values and accept the planning assumptions.]]. Click [[control:Apply selected]]. Specialist reference inputs are entered during the next review.
Click [[control:Review and calculate GPU estimate]]. The readiness panel names any missing inputs. Complete them in the guided review. Copilot has not invented reference throughput.
Set [[field:Factory users]] = [[value:One organisation]]. Set [[field:Do activities run at the same time?]] = [[value:Yes — overlapping demand]].
Set [[field:Component name 1]] = [[value:Fluid simulation]]. Set [[field:Compute location 1]] = [[value:In this factory]]. Set [[field:Reserve dedicated capacity 1]] [[state:unchecked]].
Select [[control:Fluid simulation]]. Set [[field:Sizing method]] = [[value:Reference capacity for independent work]]. This uses complete independent GPU groups and the explicit scenario assumptions.
Set [[field:Work unit]] = [[value:simulation]]. Set [[field:Peak work units per second]] = [[value:0.000138889]]. Set [[field:GPUs per reference group]] = [[value:8]].

Set [[field:Required GPU memory in GB]] = [[value:90]]. Set [[field:H200 work units per second per group]] = [[value:0.000069444]]. Set [[field:B200 work units per second per group]] = [[value:0.000092592]].

Set [[field:B300 work units per second per group]] = [[value:0.000138888]]. Set [[field:Reference source and conditions]] = [[value:Fictional consultant planning assumption for this demonstration, not measured benchmark evidence. Twelve independent CFD runs per 24h. Fixed solver/version, 20-million-cell mesh, 10,000 steps, FP64 mixed solver. Each job fits one eight-GPU group. Assumed group run times H200 4h, B200 3h, B300 2h. Rates conservatively rounded. No linear scaling of one larger mesh.]].

Check [[field:Independent reference groups can serve this demand]] and [[field:I accept this reference capacity and its scope]]. Leave [[field:Reference includes local search and indexing]] [[state:unchecked]] for this component. These example capacities are accepted planning assumptions, not measured benchmark results.

Confirm [[control:GPU estimate inputs are ready]]. Retain the displayed B300 enterprise deployment profile and [[field:Sensitivity envelope]] = [[value:±30%]]. Check [[field:Use these planning assumptions]]. Click [[control:Calculate estimate]].

Read the GPU workload comparison. Expected B300 = [[value:16]], B200 = [[value:16]], H200 = [[value:24]] GPUs. These workload counts are separate from the [[value:256]] GPU factory deployment anchor. Click [[control:Export result]] to save the calculation.

Click [[control:Continue to Design handoff]], then [[control:Prepare projection]]. Read the executive summary and download the design intake and companion specification. Unresolved network and storage measurements remain explicit.

Click [[control:Explain this to me]]. Set [[field:Explanation connection]] = [[value:DeepSeek consultant walkthrough]]. Check [[field:This saved result is public or fictional and may be sent to the selected provider]] for this fictional exercise. Click [[control:Generate explanation]]. The saved calculation cannot be changed by this action.

Read the explanation of the workload GPUs, deployment anchor, memory, storage and all network roles. Expand [[control:Source fields and assumptions]] to trace the explanation. Click [[control:Download explanation]], then [[control:Close]].

Scroll down within [[control:Explain this to me]] to read [[control:Factory networks]] and [[control:What to do next]]. Expand [[control:Source fields and assumptions]] if needed. Click [[control:Download explanation]] to save the text. Scroll to the top and click [[control:Close]] to continue.

Set [[field:Completion notes]] = [[value:Planning requirements and explanation delivered. Outstanding network and storage measurements remain in the companion specification.]]. Check [[field:I confirm that these selected requirements are delivered.]]. Click [[control:Complete engagement]].
The engagement is complete. Its exact calculation, handoff and explanation remain saved. Use [[control:Cases]] to reopen the engagement and [[control:Saved deliverables]] to retrieve its documents.

story:
Fictional customer Quartz Industrial Research. This is a planning exercise. Activities can overlap. A single organisation uses the factory. Use the exact activity name "Fluid simulation". It performs fluid simulation using a GPU solver, not a language model. Compute is inside this AI Factory. Shared capacity within its activity pool. The consultant will enter the workload-specific reference capacity and memory measurements in the guided reference form after reviewing the architecture. Do not use text-token sizing for this activity.
Do not add other activities or infer local storage from an outside corpus. Unknown storage and network measurements remain unknown.
